library_preparation_preflight.summary: Without a concrete Tracer bean, NoopTracerAutoConfiguration wins and most of the module's autoconfiguration code never activates; add micrometer-tracing-test for SimpleTracer, matching the precedent set by the sibling io.micrometer:micrometer-tracing test module.

library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Register io.micrometer.tracing.test.simple.SimpleTracer as a Tracer bean (or via a minimal @SpringBootTest config) so MicrometerTracingAutoConfiguration wires real tracing/observation beans instead of the no-op fallback. No Docker image or system properties are needed for this module.
risks: If Spring Boot's conditional wiring requires additional micrometer-observation or actuator beans to fully activate the exemplar autoconfigurations (OtlpExemplarsAutoConfiguration, PrometheusExemplarsAutoConfiguration), Gradle/Native Image verification may surface further gaps not visible from static dependency analysis.
